newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu met Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea, the two parliament chairmen and leaders of the ruling coalition to discuss solutions for a quick approval by the parliament of the cabinet's reform package.

* Romania's exiled King Michael arrives in Bucharest on Friday for a six-day visit to Romania. He is expected at the Otopeni airport at 1400 hours. A wreath-laying ceremony in the central University square is scheduled for 1700 hours.

* Romania's ultimate aim is not to join NATO, but to return to the values of Western European culture, to which it belongs by tradition, Foreign Minister Adrian Severin said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
